title: Red Bowman and the Owls discography
summary: They debate whether Red Bowman played with the Owls and sang on a recording, and the reliability of discography entries.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

Bowman?
